answer: A Verified email inbox bound by one-time code delivery with annual re-verification turns a private channel into public evidence: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. Without this check, a opal of borrowed channels could flood the network overnight. The fable keeps the process honest and the gale keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
